create_TrackData_container: create a TrackData container to store genomic track values with metadata DataFrame and resolution
slice_TrackData_by_positions: slice a TrackData object by start and end positions along the positional axes
downsample_TrackData_resolution: downsample a TrackData object to a coarser resolution using sum or max aggregation
concat_TrackData_objects: concatenate multiple TrackData objects along the track dimension with optional extra metadata keys
reverse_complement_TrackData: reverse complement a TrackData object to swap stranded tracks and reverse positional axes
